page.overview:
Who is Bennae Nalsad?

Bennae Nalsad is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

She has dark hair liberally streaked with gray worn in a silver net, and sharp, blue eyes. She is slender, in a bony way.

Bennae is is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . Along with Caren Endelle and Nisain a'Cowel, she is the joint fourth weakest Aes Sedai about which we have information.

She went to the White Tower when she was sixteen. She spent thirteen years as a novice and eleven years as Accepted before being raised to the shawl. Although her age is not known, judging by her graying hair she is probably more than 200 years old.
